the relationship between the debt to equity ratio and the return on equity on stock returns with dividend payout ratio as the intervening variable on property companies listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange in 2020.
the effect of Debt-to-Equity Ratio (DER) to stock returns.
the effect of Debt To Equity Ratio (DER), Return on Equity (ROI), and Dividend Payout (DPR) on stock returns in the property sector.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Debt to Equity Ratio, Return on Equity, and Dividend Policy have an impact on the stock returns of Property and Real Estate Subsectors on the Indonesia Stock exchange in 2014-2018.

the Debt to Equity Ratio has no effect on stock return but Return on Equity has a significant effect, the Debt to Equity ratio has a significant effect to dividend payout ratio and return on equity also has a significant effect.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between DER and stock returns is not significant, but the relationship between DER on the dividend policy is significant.
dividend policy is an important determinant of the relationship between DER and ROE with stock return.
dividend policy is a mediator variable between debt to equity ratio and stock returns, and return on equity with stock returns.
